pages.title: Crafting
pages.text: Craft near a formed operational talisman table. All 24 recipes spend one ink bottle plus paper/materials; consume is all-or-nothing and products prefer the outbox.

pages.title: Success
pages.text: Success scales with life-skill proficiency and station efficiency. Disabled stations reject soft craft; interaction auto-commissions when possible.

pages.title: Cast and Refund
pages.text: Casts reserve then commit; failures refund. CAST_* maps are mode-aware. JEI shows the full material table including ink.
